title: A chosen speed holds through play, and switching mid-run is safe
description: After picking a speed, the pace holds for a whole stretch of play including eating and scoring, and switching speed mid-run just continues the game at the new pace without a restart or error.

steps.goal: On the Snake game, start a run, choose Slow from the speed control, and play for a while: steer around, eat a piece of food, and note the score. Then switch to Fast in the middle of the same run and keep steering for a few more seconds. Watch whether the pace stays where you set it, whether the score still works, and whether anything freezes, restarts or errors when you switch.
success: The pace stayed at the speed I chose for the whole stretch of play, not drifting back
Eating food still grew the snake and raised the score while playing at a chosen speed
Switching speed mid-run did not freeze, restart or error the game; the run simply continued at the new pace
No error was shown at any point
